description:
FILED s470bt (Opus, 2026-09-06) by the B6 IR conformance corpus (7 cases).
Sibling of #1058, which fixed the LVALUE/`++` spelling; the RVALUE read is
still wrong.

PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL main cd34df72):

  my %h; my $v = $h{a}{b};
  print "keys=", scalar(keys %h), " outer=", (exists $h{a} ? 1 : 0), "\n";
  my $r; my $w = $r->{p}{q};
  print "root=", (defined $r ? 1 : 0), "\n";

  perl   keys=1 outer=1        PCL   keys=0 outer=0
         root=1                       root=0

perl's rule: every level of a multi-level subscript EXCEPT the last is an
lvalue-ish deref and vivifies, even when the whole expression is a read.
`exists $h{a}{b}` and `defined $h{a}{b}` vivify $h{a} too (perl's own
perlref: "the last level is not created").  PCL vivifies none of them, so a
program that tests `exists $h{a}` after reading through it sees a different
hash.

CORPUS CASES: 045/046/047/054/055/059/060-autoviv (plain read, exists,
defined, through a ref, three levels, `&&=`).

=== DONE (s473b) ===
FIXED s473b (Opus, 2026-09-07), commit dde02df9 (= #1150, same bug filed
twice; both close here).  The EMITTER marks a dereferenced container with
`p-viv-container` / `p-viv-array-container` and the runtime's existing chain
walker (`expand-autoviv`, the one `p-setf` reaches) expands the marker at
compile time â two one-line macros, zero run-time cost, one predicate keyed on
the AST node kind so a read, `exists`, `defined` and `delete` all get it.
Only the LAST level stays a plain read.
Also closed #1456 on the way (a DEFINED non-reference intermediate was
CLOBBERED; the four p-autoviv-* accessors now route it through
p-ensure-hashref/-arrayref, perl's symbolic-reference answer), and gave the
chain ROOT a raw-slot arm (`%p-viv-root`): boxing read-only roots so the
write-back had somewhere to go cost +97 % on an accessor loop, so a raw
lexical slot is vivified THROUGH ITS PLACE instead.
The seven ir-conform rows (045 046 047 054 055 059 060-autoviv) left
ir-conform/known-fail.tsv by edit: 298 pass / 0 fail / 47 known / 0 stale.
Bench (bench-emission-ab, controls beside): nested -1.1 %, nestedref -2.0 %,
arrhash +0.9 %, csvish +0.5 %, slices +0.0 %.  Sweep TOTAL 18674 (+0), GATE
clean after one multideref row was traded by hand (`no strict refs, exist` OUT,
`strict refs, not exist` IN).  Guards: Pl/t/autoviv-02.t rows 10-13.
RESIDUE, filed: #1349 (ref() of a NIL-holding box says "ARRAY"), #1350 (a
SINGLE-level deref read does not vivify its ref), #1352 (a deref-rooted SLICE
root with the raw-slot verdict).
